title: Procedural_Magic_UHD
description: Wavy shader pack to with colourfull effect.
body: Step into a surreal, reality-bending experience with Psychedelic Pulse. This shader completely distorts your perspective, applying a hypnotic, liquid-like wave effect across your entire field of view. To amplify the experience, the screen aggressively flashes through a shifting spectrum of vibrant, high-contrast colors every second.Not realistic but colourful.
